title: galium trifidum subsp. halophilum
intro: Galium trifidum subsp. halophilum, commonly known as Halophilous Bedstraw, is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family, characterized by its distinctive trifid leaves. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, where it is known to have potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents present in Galium trifidum subsp. halophilum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedative and diuretic effects. Further research is required to fully understand the therapeutic potential and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
